-- First, get max SER from Arctic scientific equipment
WITH arctic_stations AS (
    SELECT "STATION_name" FROM "Location" WHERE "locType" = 'Arctic'
),
arctic_scientific AS (
    SELECT se.equip_type, e."EQUIP_CODE"
    FROM "StationEquipmentType" se
    JOIN "Equipment" e ON se.equip_type = e."EquipType"
    WHERE se.station_name IN (SELECT "STATION_name" FROM arctic_stations)
    AND se.equip_type = 'Scientific'
),
ser_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        sc."measureAccPct" * CASE 
            WHEN sc."calibrStat" = 'Valid' THEN 1.0
            WHEN sc."calibrStat" = 'Due' THEN 0.7
            WHEN sc."calibrStat" = 'Expired' THEN 0.3
            ELSE 0
        END AS ser_value
    FROM "Scientific" sc
    JOIN arctic_scientific ase ON sc."equipRef" = ase."EQUIP_CODE"
),
arctic_comm AS (
    SELECT e."EQUIP_CODE"
    FROM "StationEquipmentType" se
    JOIN "Equipment" e ON se.equip_type = e."EquipType"
    WHERE se.station_name IN (SELECT "STATION_name" FROM arctic_stations)
    AND se.equip_type = 'Communication'
),
cri_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Error' THEN 0
            WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Warning' THEN 5
            WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Normal' THEN 10
            ELSE 0
        END * (1.0 - c."netLatency_ms" / 1000.0) AS cri_value
    FROM "Communication" c
    JOIN arctic_comm ace ON c."equipRef" = ace."EQUIP_CODE"
)
SELECT MAX(ser.ser_value) as max_ser, MAX(cri.cri_value) as max_cri
FROM ser_calc ser, cri_calc cri
